scraped.title: Strengthening resilience in Ninewa
scraped.subtitle: Central project evaluation of the project "Strengthening resilience in dealing with crises and conflicts in Ninewa-Iraq"
scraped.financing: Bundesministerium für wirtschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung (BMZ)
scraped.clientName: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
scraped.description: The project "Strengthening Resilience in Dealing with Crises and Conflicts in Nineveh (SRN)" aimed to strengthen the resilience of returnees, internally displaced persons (IDPs), host communities, and local institutions in Iraq’s Nineveh Governorate. This was to be achieved…
body: The project "Strengthening Resilience in Dealing with Crises and Conflicts in Nineveh (SRN)" aimed to strengthen the resilience of returnees, internally displaced persons (IDPs), host communities, and local institutions in Iraq’s Nineveh Governorate. This was to be achieved through interventions in the areas of employment, social infrastructure, and social cohesion.

ICON was conducting the central project evaluation using a theory-based approach, applying both qualitative and quantitative methods. The goal was to credibly assess the project’s impact, consider alternative explanations, and identify unintended results.
